summary.text: Phil King, a Republican attorney from Weatherford, represents Texas Senate District 10, elected in November 2022 and in office since 2023. He previously served in the Texas House from 1999 to 2022 and chairs the Senate Select Committee on Religious Liberty and the Senate Select Committee on Homeland and Border Security.

paragraphs.text: King was a police officer in Fort Worth for 15 years and continues to serve in the Texas State Guard.
He earned his B.A. and M.B.A. from Dallas Baptist University and a law degree from Texas A&M University School of Law.
In the 2025 special sessions Lieutenant Governor Dan Patrick tapped him to chair the Senate Special Committee on Congressional Redistricting.
He serves on the national board of directors of the American Legislative Exchange Council and lives in Weatherford with his wife, Terry.
